title: Orders cannot connect to a healthy payments
query: Orders cannot connect to payments, connection refused, but payments is up and its health check passes.
root_cause: Orders was deployed with a wrong payments endpoint (wrong port), so every payment call is refused.

remediation.detail: Roll orders back to the previous version and configuration (v1.0.0).

evidence: Orders logs show payment failed with a connection refused error
Payments health endpoint answers and payments logs show no incoming requests
